# American Heart Association

> > The American Heart Association is a relentless force for longer, healthier lives through CPR training, cardiovascular disease prevention, and evidence-based health initiatives.

The American Heart Association (AHA) is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to fighting heart disease and stroke. The site provides comprehensive resources on CPR and emergency response, heart-healthy living through Life's Essential 8, nutrition guidance with Heart-Check certification, and community support networks.

## Key Topics

- American Heart Association
- Life's Essential 8
- CPR and Emergency Cardiovascular Care
- Heart-Check Mark Certification
- Healthy for Good Movement
- F.A.S.T. (Stroke Recognition)
- Cardiovascular Health
- Heart Disease Prevention
- Heart-Healthy Eating
- Nutrition Education
- Tobacco Cessation
- Mental Health and Wellness
- Habit Building
- Sleep Health
- Weight Management

## Emergency Response & CPR Training

- [American Heart Association CPR and First Aid](https://cpr.heart.org/en): CPR, first aid, and Emergency Cardiovascular Care training with Hands-Only CPR
- [Heart Attack, Stroke and Cardiac Arrest Symptoms](https://www.heart.org/en/about-us/heart-attack-and-stroke-symptoms): Guide to recognizing heart attack, stroke, and cardiac arrest symptoms using F.A.S.T.

## Healthy Living & Wellness

- [Healthy for Good](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living): Healthy for Good movement promoting nutrition, fitness, and Life's Essential 8
- [Healthy Lifestyle](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle): Comprehensive healthy lifestyle guide covering Life's Essential 8 and wellness
- [Life's Essential 8](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/lifes-essential-8): Life's Essential 8 cardiovascular health framework and wellness checklist
- [Mental Health and Well-being](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/mental-health-and-wellbeing): Mental health guide covering stress management and mindfulness practices
- [Sleep](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/sleep): Sleep health guide covering sleep duration, habits, and cardiovascular benefits
- [Habits](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/habits): Building healthy habits guide with Habit Coach and behavior modification
- [Quit Vaping - Quit Smoking - Quit Tobacco](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/quit-smoking-tobacco): Tobacco cessation guide with quit smoking strategies and youth prevention

## Heart-Healthy Eating & Nutrition

- [Healthy Eating](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating): Heart-healthy eating guide with Heart-Check certification and recipe resources
- [Recipes](https://recipes.heart.org/en): Heart-healthy recipes low in sodium, fat, and sugar following AHA criteria
- [Healthy Food Facts](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/healthy-food-facts): Nutrition education on sodium, sugar, fats, and balanced diet choices
- [Eat Smart](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/eat-smart): Nutrition tips on smart food choices and Heart-Check mark certification
- [Heart-Check Foods](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/heart-check-foods): Heart-Check certified foods guide for heart-healthy grocery shopping
- [Add Color](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/add-color): Guide to adding fruits and vegetables to meals for heart health
- [Cooking Skills](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/cooking-skills): Cooking skills guide with videos on meal preparation and heart-healthy recipes
- [Losing Weight](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-eating/losing-weight): Weight management guide with healthy weight loss strategies and benefits

## Community Education & Support

- [Volunteering with the American Heart Association](https://www.heart.org/en/volunteer): Volunteer opportunities with American Heart Association and Heart Club programs
- [Nutrition Education Lessons](https://www.heart.org/en/healthy-living/healthy-lifestyle/nutrition-education-lessons): Community-based nutrition education with lesson plans and bilingual resources

## Homepage

- [American Heart Association | To be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives](https://www.heart.org): American Heart Association homepage with CPR training, support networks, and health initiatives
